from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of hollow rectangular frames.

    Even-by-even interior dimensions are filled with 2; if either interior
    dimension is odd, fill with 7.
    """
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = set()
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.add((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if (0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and
                            grid[yy][xx] == color and (yy, xx) not in seen):
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells)
            r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells)
            c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = set()
            for x in range(c0, c1 + 1):
                border.add((r0, x))
                border.add((r1, x))
            for y in range(r0, r1 + 1):
                border.add((y, c0))
                border.add((y, c1))
            if cells == border:
                fill = 2 if (r1 - r0 - 1) % 2 == 0 and (c1 - c0 - 1) % 2 == 0 else 7
                for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                    for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                        out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
